_about: English rendering of each query, feeding the dense_translated channel (aic run --english).
CLIP's text tower is trained on English; measured on the mock set, targets unreachable from
the Vietnamese text (beyond rank 4,000) land at rank 1-2 from a paraphrase like these.
Written for the image tower, not for a reader: concrete nouns, visible objects, colours, no
instruction phrasing, no reasoning about what the scene means.
The raw Vietnamese query keeps its own channel, so a poor rendering degrades this run rather
